parameters.name: ContactFlowId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact flow to associate with the phone number.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the call center instance to which you want to add the phone number.

parameters.name: Usage
parameters.description:
The purpose of the phone number. Valid values:

- **Inbound**: inbound calls only.
- **Outboung**: outbound calls only.
- **Bidirection**: both inbound and outbound calls.

> If the phone number is a 400 number, set this parameter to **Inbound** only.
